about:
I'm **BaconedXD**, a Minecraft staff member with hands-on experience across vanilla and SMP communities ranging from 200 to 8,400+ members.

Right now I'm the **Staff Manager at BlazeVanilla** and a **Moderator at BreezeVanilla**. Before that I led media teams at SpaceMC and CloverMC, helped manage CloverMC, and moderated at DomikonSMP — so I've done staff work from the front line all the way up to management.
